description: Single stacked bar chart occupying one shared plot area. Repeated vertical bars across the horizontal axis, each bar composed of multiple stacked rectangular segments of varying heights. Small gaps between bars; overall bar heights vary. All data-encoding marks are rectangles (stacked segments).

primary.explanation: 12 months distributed along the x axis as separate bars

secondary.explanation: Five weather categories stacked vertically within each bar
